desc: Parse S into a rooted ordered forest using a stack; attach top-level nodes to a virtual root.

Verify the operation semantics: reversing a valid substring reverses a consecutive block of siblings and recurses inside each; adjacent swaps achievable → all child permutations at every node, and nothing else.
Design DP: group children by unordered canonical type; c(node) = ((Σm)! / Π m_i!) * Π c(type_i)^{m_i}.

Prove the formula: distinct unordered types yield disjoint string sets (string determines ordered tree hence unordered type); within a class each copy independently takes one of c_i forms; multinomial counts type orderings.
Implement with iterative post-order traversal, precomputed factorials and inverse factorials mod 998244353; answer = c(virtual root).
Test on samples: (())() → 2, () → 1, plus brute-force BFS verification on small N.
